title: Admiral Wilson returns to close out a project at Area 51

tellings.quote: all I know is he said I'm back because I've got to go back up into that he he wouldn't say Area 51. I knew what he was talking about.

plain: A Navy admiral named Thomas R. Wilson came back to Las Vegas sometime between 1997 and 2002 because, he said, he had to go back up "into that" place to close out a project, and he would not say Area 51, the secret test site in the Nevada desert. A scientist who has worked for the Pentagon, Eric W. Davis, tells Michels the admiral said this to him and that he knew what Wilson meant. If it is true, a senior admiral was personally tied to a secret project at the site.
